brand_voice_note: Warm, plain-spoken and partnership-led, celebrating named collaborators and real causes over hype.

copy_claims: Gold Glove Blend made in collaboration with Ian Happ
One of the components in this blend is a coffee from Rwanda , in East Africa. It brings a bright, citrus note to the blend.
The other component comes from Guatemala and offers more traditional coffee notes.
It's a medium roast made up of beans from two completely different parts of the world
concepts.primary_text:
One blend, two continents, one seriously smooth cup.

We built the Gold Glove Blend with Chicago Cubs outfielder Ian Happ - bright, citrusy beans from Rwanda married to traditional, full-bodied beans from Guatemala.

A medium roast that's as smooth as his fielding. Whole bean or ground, your call. ⚾
concepts.headline: Rwanda meets Guatemala
concepts.why_it_works: The two-origin medium roast built with a named ballplayer is a story only this brand can tell, so the Origin angle shows the raw beans behind the collaboration.
concepts.visual_direction: The Gold Glove pouch standing on a roastery counter between a pile of raw green beans and roasted beans, with a burlap sack and scoop alongside.

copy_claims: Morale Blend made in collaboration with Morale Supply Co.
This collaboration with Morale Supply Co.™ - which has been delivering morale to Chicago since 2014 - is a medium-dark roast
each bag sold supports First Tee - Greater Chicago
One pound equals one hour of programming at First Tee
since we started working together in April 2021, Morale has provided more than 1,800 hours of programming for youth in Chicago
concepts.primary_text:
Bold coffee that gives back with every bag.

Morale Blend is a medium-dark roast made with Morale Supply Co. - a little extra time in the roaster for a bold cup that never turns bitter.

Every pound sold equals one hour of programming at First Tee - Greater Chicago. Since April 2021 that's over 1,800 hours for Chicago youth.
concepts.headline: Bolder. Not Bitter.
concepts.why_it_works: The buyer wants a strong cup that isn't harsh, so callout labels lifted straight from the bag prove the roast level and character before the click.
concepts.visual_direction: The Morale Blend pouch standing on a clean grey studio surface beside an espresso cup, with thin labels pointing to its roast and origin claims.

copy_claims: The family-owned and operated Ramirez Estate in the Jarabacoa region of the DR
which has been producing coffee since 1943
We roast it to a medium-dark level, which leads to a bolder, more complex cup
There’s an earthiness and almost smokiness to it, with notes of tobacco
This is one for fans of bold coffee
concepts.primary_text:
For the slow morning that deserves a bolder cup.

Our Dominican Ramirez is single-origin from the family-run Ramirez Estate in Jarabacoa, farming coffee since 1943. We've visited Eddy on his farm ourselves.

Roasted medium-dark for an earthy, complex cup with a hint of sweet tobacco. One for fans of bold coffee. ☕
concepts.headline: Bold, earthy, single-origin
concepts.why_it_works: The rich single-origin bag suits a quiet weekend-morning ritual, so a warm styled kitchen scene sets the mood without needing on-image text.
concepts.visual_direction: The matte-black Dominican Ramirez pouch on a warm wood table beside a French press, a mug of black coffee and scattered beans in soft morning light.
